drills.title: Pass & Move Square

bands.area: a 15x15m square
bands.note: Two-touch minimum at this age — a controlling touch, then a pass.

bands.area: an 18x18m square
a 20x20m square
bands.note: One-touch where the pass is on.

instructions: Half the group with a ball each, half without; everyone moves freely inside the square
Players with a ball pass to a free player, then sprint to find new space
Build through: pass and follow, one-two, then pass and move away from the ball
Raise the tempo every two minutes until passes are firm and first touches are out of the feet
progressions: Call "switch" — the ball must be moved to the opposite half of the square within two passes.
regressions: Walk the movement pattern first with one ball between four.
drills.tip: Watch the player after they pass — the warm-up is really about the run they make next.

drills.title: Rondo Circle Warm-Up

bands.area: a 10m circle of cones
bands.note: Unlimited touches to start; move to two-touch once passes are clean.

bands.area: an 8m circle of cones

instructions: Outside players keep the ball moving across and around the circle; one defender starts in the middle
A misplaced pass or an interception swaps the passer with the defender
Ask for disguise: look one way, pass the other
progressions: Add a second defender so the passing angles halve.
regressions: Remove the defender and count consecutive passes instead.
drills.tip: Feet alive before the ball arrives — the rondo fails when receivers stand flat-footed.

drills.title: Sharks & Minnows

bands.area: a 20x15m area
a 25x20m area

instructions: All players but one start on the end line with a ball; one or two sharks start in the middle without one
On the call, everyone dribbles to the far line without losing their ball
A player whose ball is kicked out becomes a shark for the next round
Last player with a ball wins the round
progressions: Sharks may leave the middle zone and press across the whole area.
regressions: Widen the area and cap the sharks at one for longer.
drills.tip: The quiet coaching point is head-up dribbling — nobody survives round three watching their feet.

drills.title: Receive & Turn Through Gates

bands.area: a 20x20m area with six 3m cone gates
a 25x25m area with eight 2m cone gates
bands.note: Receivers check away before showing for the ball.

instructions: Pairs, one ball: receive through any gate, turn, and pass through a different gate to your partner
First touch takes you through the gate — not a stop, then a dribble
Change the turn every three minutes: inside hook, outside hook, sole roll
Count gates as points for the last two minutes
progressions: Passer follows their pass to press gently — the receiver's touch must now beat a real body.
regressions: Receive through the gate with no turn: control, then play back.
drills.tip: The touch should answer a question: where is the space, and what touch takes me into it?

drills.title: 4v2 Rondo

bands.area: a 12x12m grid
a 10x10m grid
an 8x8m grid

instructions: Four outside players keep the ball from two defenders inside the grid
Splitting the two defenders with a pass scores a point
The passer who loses the ball swaps with the longest-serving defender
Ten passes without loss also scores
progressions: Outside players must move one cone clockwise after each pass.
drills.tip: The angle beats the pass — receivers should always give the passer two options, never one.

drills.title: Press the Back Line

bands.area: a 40x30m pitch with two small goals at one end
half a pitch with two small goals at one end

instructions: Back four plus keeper build out; three pressers hunt in a triangle, cutting the pitch in half
Triggers to press: a bouncing ball, a heavy touch, a pass into a player facing their own goal
Pressers win it and finish in either small goal within eight seconds
Rotate the pressing trio every three minutes — pressing is sprinting
progressions: Add a fourth presser and ask for a full trap on the touchline.
regressions: Build-up team plays two-touch, slowing the picture down for the pressers.
drills.tip: The first presser sets the trap, the second makes the tackle — press in relays, not in a mob.

drills.title: Build-Up Through Thirds

bands.area: a 40x30m pitch split into three equal thirds
half a pitch split into three thirds

instructions: Keeper and back players start in the first third; the ball must touch every third on the way to goal
Defenders press only in their own third to start, so the picture stays readable
Centre-backs split wide, midfielder drops between them when pressed
Score normally at the far end; playing back to restart is always allowed
progressions: One defender may follow the ball into the next third, making every zone live.
regressions: Attackers walk-press for the first phase.
drills.tip: Play the way the press shows you — if they jump on the centre-back, the midfielder is free by definition.

drills.title: Break at Speed 4v3

bands.area: a 40x30m pitch with one full goal
half a pitch with one full goal

instructions: Coach serves into the deepest attacker; four break against three recovering defenders
First pass goes forward; the winger's first touch attacks the outside shoulder
Shot away within twelve seconds, or the defenders win the round
Rotate attack and defence every three waves
progressions: One defender starts goal-side, making the picture 4v3 plus a sweeper.
drills.tip: Counters die in the second pass — the first is instinct, the second is the decision that makes the goal.

drills.title: Defend the Box 3v3

bands.area: the penalty area with a full goal and keeper
the penalty area with a full goal and keeper

instructions: Three defenders protect the box against three attackers fed by wide servers
Defenders mark goal-side and ball-side, front-post runner tracked first
Every clearance must find a target, not just distance — a marked-out clearing gate each side
Five deliveries per round; defenders score for clean clearances, attackers for shots on target
progressions: Add a second wave attacker on the edge of the box for cut-backs.
regressions: Serves are rolled along the floor, not crossed.
drills.tip: Attack the ball or attack the man — standing between the two defends neither.

drills.title: Distribution Gates

bands.area: half a pitch with three cone gates at 15, 25 and 35m
half a pitch with three cone gates at 20, 35 and 50m

instructions: From a caught ball: roll through the near gate, throw over the middle gate, side-volley or pass to the far gate
Each distribution follows a real save — catch, scan, release inside four seconds
Score each accurate delivery; five rounds, keep totals
progressions: A passive presser closes the keeper after the catch.
regressions: No time limit; walk through the scan-then-release pattern.
drills.tip: The save is half the job — the first thought after catching is always "who is my out-ball?"

drills.title: Lose It, Win It Back

bands.area: a 35x30m area with two small goals at each end
a 40x35m area with two small goals at each end

instructions: Normal game, but a team that regains the ball within four seconds of losing it earns a point
Points for regains are tracked separately from goals and announced at the end
The nearest three players press; everyone else compacts the space behind
progressions: A regain plus a goal within eight seconds counts triple.
drills.tip: Scoring the regain separately makes it visible — teams start valuing it within one session.

drills.title: Cool Down & Review

bands.area: the centre circle

instructions: Two laps at jogging pace, then walk into a circle
Static stretches: quads, hamstrings, calves, hips — 20 seconds each while the coach reviews
One question to the group: "What would you do differently next time?" — take three answers
drills.tip: End on a name-check: one specific thing one specific player did well tonight.
